=== SEGMENT 2 STAGE 2 NOTES ===
--- NOTE: A Keeper Need Not Watch the Lens.md ---
# A Keeper Need Not Watch the Lens[^1]

Obviously, a keeper can take no notice of the lens on a clear night.
On a foggy night it is no help at all.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

--- NOTE: Rings of Prisms.md ---
---
tags: [lighthouses]
---
# Rings of Prisms[^1]

*The Fresnel lens* uses rings of prisms instead of one thick glass.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

--- NOTE: The Lens Makes a Beam.md ---
# The Lens Makes a Beam[^1]

The lens bends light into a beam. A beam carries farther than a glow.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]
